description: Figure 6(a) is a vertical bar chart titled “Self-reflection SFT data statistic,” illustrating the distribution of samples across five distinct reasoning-type categories. The horizontal axis lists these categories in the order: “Other Math,” “Geometric Math,” “Charts Diagrams,” “Natural Science,” and “General Reasoning.” The vertical axis, labeled “Number of Samples,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 14,000, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 2,000. Each bar is colored orange and topped with a numerical label indicating its exact value: the “Other Math” bar reaches 14,333; the “Geometric Math” bar reaches 10,227; the “Charts Diagrams” bar reaches 5,953; the “Natural Science” bar reaches 3,343; and the “General Reasoning” bar reaches 3,534. The bars are presented in descending order of height from left to right, with no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any individual bar.
